items.title: Mona Hinton interviewed by Milt Fillius and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: to the day he died he would never call me anything but Mrs. Hinton... 'you have a baby, you’re a lady, I can’t call you anything but Mrs. Hinton.'

ctx.x: Well you see what happened was, we traveled, and then when Charlotte was born, Milton came home and he went into the recording studios. So while, you know, he went on the road to Japan with Louis Armstrong in ‘53 I believe it was, and he came back and he said he ... Milton had studied with the best teachers in the whole wide world, and really became very proficient on his instrument. But he could not stand to stay in that band and just play the same music day in and day out, it was killing him. So he said he…
Louis’ show was pretty cut and dried, wasn’t it?
